entities.name: Sebastião Rodrigues Soromenho
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sebastião Rodrigues Soromenho, was a Portuguese explorer, born in Sesimbra (Portugal), appointed by King Philip II of Spain to sail along the shores of California, in the years 1595 and 1596, in order to map the American west coast line and define the maritime routes of the Pacific Ocean in the 16th century.
